content: While taking this medication, it is essential to undergo regular comprehensive physical examinations. These should include laboratory and/or medical tests such as blood pressure monitoring, breast examinations or mammograms, pelvic examinations, and Pap smears. Follow your doctor’s instructions for self-examining your breasts, and promptly report any lumps or abnormalities. Ensure that you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose of this medication, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Dispose of this product properly when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in August 2024. It is important to note that this document provides a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal supplements, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Certain medications, such as rifamycins (e.g., rifampin), may affect the removal of medroxyprogesterone from your body, potentially altering its effectiveness. This medication may also interfere with specific laboratory tests, potentially leading to false results. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911) immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669.
